scope: Open review of work-related asthma, including sensitizer-induced occupational asthma, latency, and removal from exposure.

keyRecommendations.text: Sensitizer-induced disease has a latency of months or years; earlier onset is associated with higher exposure.
High-molecular-weight agents are proteins of animal or vegetable origin.
Early diagnosis and complete removal of exposure are the most effective interventions for prevention and treatment.

clinicalBottomLine: Separate sensitizer-induced occupational asthma from other work-related asthma. The most effective step in this review is early diagnosis and complete removal of the causative exposure.
notableCaveats: The 2008 ACCP consensus is not in PMC. Serial PEF is discussed as a simple monitoring method, not as a numeric diagnostic cutoff.
